key_facts.reason_jp: 業績上方修正に伴う増配：主要クリエイティブ分野(日本)及び医療分野の業績順調、2025年3月連結子会社化した高橋書店Gの業績好調

name_jp: クリーク・アンド・リバー社
summary_en: FY2/27 dividend per share raised ¥1.00 to ¥51.00 (from ¥50.00). Period end only (no interim). Full-year earnings forecast revised upward: operating profit ¥5,450M (+3.8%), net income ¥3,450M (+3.0%). Increase driven by strong creative (Japan) and medical divisions, plus Takahashi Shoten Group acquisition contribution. Target payout ratio 30%.
summary_jp: FY2/27配当 ¥51.00/株（+¥1.00）に増配。営業利益 ¥5,450M (+3.8%)、当期純利益 ¥3,450M (+3.0%) に修正。創作分野（日本）・医療分野好調、高橋書店G（子会社化）寄与。配当性向30%水準を基本方針。
tag_en: Dividend Hike - FY2/27 - ¥51.00/share (+¥1.00) - ~30% payout ratio target
